newsitem.title: JAPAN: Calsonic to buy Tokyo Radiator shares from Isuzu.
newsitem.headline: Calsonic to buy Tokyo Radiator shares from Isuzu.

text.p: Calsonic Corp said on Friday it would acquire 2.17 million shares in Tokyo Radiator Manufacturing Co Ltd from Isuzu Motors Ltd.
A Calsonic official said that the company would purchase Isuzu's 20 percent stake in Tokyo Radiator on March 26.
As a result, Calsonic, an auto parts maker affiliated with Nissan Motor Co Ltd, will replace Isuzu as Tokyo Radiator's largest shareholder, Calsonic said in a statement.
Tokyo Radiator develops and makes aluminium radiators for medium- and large-sized trucks with technological assistance provided by Calsonic, the statement said.
